name: lying leg raise (modified)
description: An easier lying leg raise that trains the lower abs. Bent knees reduce the strain on the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until your hips flex to about 90 degrees.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop short of the floor and repeat.
